n48a413da2d.headline: Iran may accept EU nuclear deal proposal, wants assurances
n48a413da2d.summary: Iran says it wants assurances that no future US president would rescind the nuclear deal if it accepts the European Union's proposal to return to the agreement.
n48a413da2d.why: The Iran nuclear deal governs potential sanctions relief on Iranian oil and trade, which affects energy markets and Middle East risk.

n0f58eb464f.headline: U.S. and Switzerland working on facilitating pharma trade – U.S. ambassador
n0f58eb464f.summary: The US ambassador said Washington and Bern can move toward free trade through sectoral deals and are working on facilitating pharmaceutical trade. The remarks were made in Zurich.
n0f58eb464f.why: Switzerland hosts major drugmakers, so trade terms for pharmaceuticals affect the export revenues and supply chains of large global healthcare companies.

n9584ac79e6.headline: Philippine bourse sees firms raising $3.6b on capital markets this year
n9584ac79e6.summary: Companies have raised $3.6 billion on the Philippine stock exchange's capital markets this year. In 2021, a record amount was raised through IPOs.
n9584ac79e6.why: Capital raising through equity and IPOs signals investor appetite and corporate funding activity on the Philippine Stock Exchange.
